items.text: if a scene's picture fails to load once (a moment offline, an update landing), it is tried again soon after and as soon as the connection is back, instead of showing the outline for the rest of the visit
the tools in the shelf under the bar show the moving dots under the ones running (the words playing, a loop, a room), like the row above
certificates carry the duck-rabbit, with your club under it: Founders 100 Club, 500 or 1000, and your founder number. All thirteen paths make it the Current Pathfinders Badge
the founder number is your place among the sign-ups, found with the email you joined with; the credits show it beside your name

certificates for the Paths. Finish paths 01 to 07, or 08 to 13, or all thirteen, and a certificate opens: a card made from the scene you are playing, in the color and texture you pick, with your name, what you walked and the date, and what is left. Keep it or share it; open it again any time from Paths
Founders Club members can sign theirs into Current's credits, with the name as they want it to appear. Names are added by hand and then show in the colophon under Founders Club

dice rhythms (Pro, open in beta). Drag the dice down: beside the units, a switch tapped round PAIR, FIBO and PRIME changes the counts on the beads (2 4 8…, 1 2 3 5 8 13…, 2 3 5 7 11 13…) in seconds, beats or bars. A bead holds that count; the pair of dice picks one of them at random each time, or, held, steps through them in order
the dice's units are pictures as well as words: seconds a stopwatch, beats the ticks lit, bars the line under them lit
in the random matrix the ground's row just says Ground color, like the others (still off until you switch it on)

the performance board (Pro, open in beta), for playing live with the output on another screen. In the Room tool: board. The stage takes the output's shape (16:9 until one is open) in the top corner; beside it, the panels you open stay open side by side, and a new one replaces the oldest when there is no room; under the stage, a strip of the controls you play most

the strip is yours: hold a control (or tap the pencil) and everything jiggles: drag to reorder, × takes one off, + adds buttons and sliders (sound level, flow, speed, strength, reach, trails and more). Five boards come with it (Play, Scenes, Sound, Color, Touch), the stage can sit left or right, and save board keeps your own
the board needs a window at least 900 × 560; on a phone the stage stays as it is
a short shelf above the bar sits over its button; a shelf as wide as the bar or wider sits centred over the bar, and only its little point moves to its button
